name: Quess Corp Ltd
title: Quess Corp Ltd - 539978 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Quess FY26 EBITDA up 19% to INR 312 cr on margin mix shift (Professional Staffing 12%, General Staffing 1.5%), but revenue grew only 2%; General Staffing supply-side growth still muted.

triggers.label: Sourcing delivery 37-38k vs 50k capacity
triggers.quote: The last two quarters, we have been able to deliver only 37 ,000 and 38,000 out of that installed capacity of 50,000.

triggers.label: Professional Staffing margin 12%+ sustained
triggers.quote: we would continue to remain and measure ourselves in the 11-12% margin category for the medium term as well.

triggers.label: General Staffing net adds ~50% of capacity
triggers.quote: At 26,000, I would say we have performed at 50% of our installed capacity.

triggers.label: FY27 PS headcount +10-11%, revenue +12-13%
triggers.quote: we will be able to come back on a 10% to 11% headcount growth and 12% to 13% revenue growth.
